title: Driver Age, Licence and Contract Length Limits — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
Every driver of a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental vehicle must meet the class's minimum age and licence class. Each class also fixes the most rental periods one contract may run, extensions included, whether the vehicle may be returned to a different facility, whether a rental may be extended after pickup, and how many elapsed hours before the scheduled return time an extension must be requested by.

| Vehicle class | Minimum age of every driver (years) | Driver's licence required | Most rental periods per contract, extensions included | One-way return to a different facility | Extension after pickup | Extension requested at least (elapsed hours before scheduled return) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Pickup Truck | 18 | Standard class C or D | 3 | Not allowed | Allowed | 2 |
| Bluegate Cargo Van | 18 | Standard class C or D | 3 | Not allowed | Allowed | 2 |
| Bluegate 10 ft Moving Truck | 18 | Standard class C or D | 3 | Not allowed | Allowed | 2 |
| Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck | 18 | Standard class C or D | 3 | Not allowed | Allowed | 2 |
| Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck | 21 | Standard class C or D | 3 | Not allowed | Allowed | 4 |
| Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck | 21 | Standard class C or D | 3 | Not allowed | Allowed | 4 |

## Points of reading

- The minimum age is 18 on the four smaller classes and 21 on the Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck and the Bluegate 26 ft Moving Truck.
- A standard class C or D licence is the requirement on every class.
- No class allows a one-way return, and every class allows an extension after pickup, within the limit of 3 rental periods per contract.
- The extension request lead is 2 elapsed hours on the four smaller classes and 4 elapsed hours on the two largest.
